(def ^{:doc "Given a map of replacement pairs and a vector/collection, returns a
  vector/seq with any elements = a key in smap replaced with the
  corresponding val in smap. Returns a transducer when no collection
  is provided." :arglists '([smap] [smap coll])} replace
  (fn
    ([smap]
     (map (fn [x] (if-let [e (find smap x)] (val e) x))))
    ([smap coll]
     (if (vector? coll)
       (let [n (count coll)]
         (reduce (fn [v i]
                   (if-let [e (find smap (nth v i))]
                     (assoc v i (second e))
                     v))
           coll (take n (iterate inc 0))))
       (map (fn [x] (if-let [e (find smap x)] (second e) x)) coll)))))
rationale: Retain every pinned replace branch and both arities: eager vector updates retaining unchanged owner/metadata, lazy sequence replacement, and the map transducer. Expand defn and shorthand functions only; keep find/val/second, assoc, reduce, take and iterate as live source dependencies. This is a dependency of emit-defrecord field substitutions, not evidence that records are implemented.
